releaseNotes: FIXED: Workbook Audit actions now actually execute — Convert to Number, Fix Safe, Apply Selected and Unhide Sheet were silently refused in beta.25 by a faulty live check; the real Excel formula contract (Range.HasFormula) is now used and every action reaches the workbook.
FIXED: Guided action checkboxes toggle on the first click — the six Unhide Sheet actions are now selectable and applicable (single, bulk, or mixed with safe fixes in one backup + confirmation).
NEW: stage-by-stage action diagnostics in the audit log — command invocation, validation verdicts with reasons, mutations and verification can never fail silently again.
IMPROVED: refused actions now name their exact reason in the window (stale target, workbook changed, protected structure) instead of a generic message.
IMPROVED: unsaved workbooks get their action backup in Elmashad's backup folder with an explicit log line.
